symbolic_mapping: the tear represents division in a relational bond
the persistent red color signifies enduring emotional valence despite rupture
philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The image visualizes the tension between continuity of affect and physical separation within social bonds, suggesting that relational identity may persist even when structural unity is broken.
alternative_interpretations: It may simply depict a craft activity involving paper heart decoration without symbolic intent.
limitations: No contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; the meaning relies entirely on conventional associations of heart imagery and tearing.

symbolic_mapping: selective color highlights emotional content over material context
irregular tear implies non-idealized, human-scale rupture
